verdict.line: You lose grinding poke wars where his ranged Cleaver chips your max health while Adrenaline Rush heals him back; you win by forcing one clean Rupture-into-Feral-Scream all-in before the lane turns into a stalemate he's built to win.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo's kit is built for attrition: Infected Cleaver pokes from 975 range for a percentage of your max health, and Adrenaline Rush regenerates him every second after, so a straight poke war against a tanky target with sustain this strong is a trap. Cho'Gath has no ranged poke of his own — Vorpal Spikes only triggers on melee autos — so this matchup compresses to whether you can land one clean Rupture-into-Feral-Scream all-in before it becomes a stalemate. Worse, every Feast stack raises your own max health, which only makes you a juicier Cleaver target as the game goes on — the real reason this sits below Cho'Gath's average win rate.

theirWindow.what: He free-pokes with Infected Cleaver for percent-health damage and Adrenaline Rush heals it straight back, and you have no ranged reply — back off minion range instead of trading melee autos into it.

yourWindow.when: the instant he overextends past minions
yourWindow.what: Knock him up with Rupture (Q), follow immediately with Feral Scream (W) to Silence him — this shuts off his Infected Cleaver and Burning Agony casts — then stack Vorpal Spikes autos and land Feast (R) true damage before Adrenaline Rush stabilizes him.

start.why: Mundo's Infected Cleaver is a free 4-second-cooldown ranged poke you can't trade back against at level 1-2; the extra mana lets you actually hold Rupture (Q) for a real engage instead of running dry.

boots.why: Mundo has no hard CC to dodge, so the highest-winrate pick (48.9%) is the movement speed that lets you close the gap to melee range and stick in Feast (R) range (175) during your short all-in window.

core.why: The dash-and-burst closes distance on a target who's otherwise just kiting you with ranged Cleavers, turning your short all-in window into a guaranteed one.
Health and omnivamp let you out-sustain Adrenaline Rush instead of losing the war of attrition his passive is designed to win.
Bonus health plus a movement speed steroid keeps you stuck to him long enough to land Feast (R) before he disengages.

situational.when: he's stacking Masochism autos and threatens real burst damage on you
his Adrenaline Rush sustain is out-healing your damage in extended fights
the game goes long and you need more frontline health for teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: The burst attack speed window maximizes Vorpal Spikes procs the instant you land Rupture, front-loading your damage into the all-in before his per-second Adrenaline Rush regen can answer it.

summoners.why: Teleport is the standard pick (67.1%) for managing waves against his ranged poke and keeping your scaling intact; Flash extends your Rupture engage range to catch him before he can disengage. Flash+Ignite is a viable alternative if you want to press the solo-kill edge Cho'Gath holds in this matchup.

playing.title: Track the Cleaver cooldown
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver is only 4 seconds — don't walk into minion range right after he's thrown one assuming you're safe, he can reload fast.

playing.title: Save Rupture for the all-in
playing.detail: Don't spend Q poking minions or wasting it on a half-trade; hold it for the moment he's isolated so you can chain straight into Feral Scream.

playing.title: Never poke-war him
playing.detail: Adrenaline Rush out-regens drawn-out exchanges every time — commit to a full combo or don't engage at all.

playing.title: Respect low-HP Mundo
playing.detail: Masochism scales his attack damage off missing health, so a Mundo under 30% HP hits harder in melee than he did at full — don't relax the trade just because he looks weak.

playing.title: Prioritize Feast for true damage
playing.detail: Feast (R) ignores his regen and resistances entirely — land it inside every all-in to guarantee burst Adrenaline Rush can't erase.

playing.title: Silence stops his tools
playing.detail: Feral Scream's Silence cuts off his Infected Cleaver throws and Burning Agony activation mid-fight, so time it to interrupt rather than just for the damage.

playing.title: Don't let your HP balloon unchecked
playing.detail: Every Feast kill stack raises your max health and makes future Cleavers hit harder in absolute numbers — play slightly more cautious around his Q as your stacks climb.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by (Q) during early game. Focus on farming lane while poking to gain the upper hand in combat.
